title: Pass 3 reference table: actomyosin peristaltic contraction waves and shuttle streaming in Physarum polycephalum coupled to the Tero et al. (2010) adaptive Kirchhoff-Poiseuille tube network
provenance_note: DOIs below could not be re-verified offline during Pass 3 (no network access permitted). Alim et al. (2013) was already vendored with its DOI in paper_citations.bib. Numeric values marked value_provenance = 'recalled' are quoted from memory of the cited text and must be checked against the paper by the auditor.

primary_sources.citation: Alim K, Amselem G, Peaudecerf F, Brenner MP, Pringle A (2013) Random network peristalsis in Physarum polycephalum organizes fluid flows across an individual. Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA 110(33):13306-13311
primary_sources.role: Peristaltic contraction wave of the tube walls drives shuttle streaming; the wave spans the whole individual (wavelength ~ organism size), which maximizes net transport; flows across the network are modelled as Poiseuille flow in tubes with time-varying radius

primary_sources.citation: Kamiya N (1981) Physical and chemical basis of cytoplasmic streaming. Annual Review of Plant Physiology 32:205-236
primary_sources.role: Classical description of rhythmic shuttle streaming in Physarum plasmodia: the endoplasm reverses direction periodically (period of the order of 1-2 min) in phase with rhythmic tube-wall contraction

primary_sources.citation: Tero A, Kobayashi R, Nakagaki T (2007) J. Theor. Biol. 244(4):553-564
primary_sources.role: Tube adaptation dD/dt = f(|Q|) - mu D where Q is interpreted as the flux through the tube; the slow-timescale coupling here feeds the cycle-averaged |Q| of the shuttle flow into f

contraction_period_s.note: Period of the actomyosin contraction / shuttle-streaming cycle. Treated as an input T_c of the reduced model; the model time unit 1/mu is anchored to ADAPTATION_TIME_S = 1800 s (model-scale assumption, unsourced).

flow_reversals_per_contraction_cycle.note: Endoplasmic flow reverses twice per contraction period; the reduced model must reproduce 2 sign changes of Q_e(t) per cycle on tubes dominated by the shuttle component.

fraction_of_tubes_with_reversing_flow.source: alim2013random (qualitative: oscillatory flows observed throughout the network)
fraction_of_tubes_with_reversing_flow.note: Steady source-sink Kirchhoff flow (eps = 0 ablation) gives 0 reversals; the peristaltic model should drive reversal on essentially all tubes.

optimal_wavelength_over_organism_length.note: Alim et al. report that the peristaltic wavelength matches the organism size and that this maximizes net transport. The reduced model scans lambda / L in [0.25, 8] and reports the argmax of the cycle-averaged net transport sum_e |<Q_e>| L_e (order-of-magnitude agreement expected, not a fitted value).

oscillatory_to_net_flow_dominance.note: Shuttle streaming velocities greatly exceed the net transport velocity; the reduced model reports the oscillatory/steady flux rms ratio at the calibrated eps without a numeric reference.

model_scale_parameters.calibration_disclosure: eps_default was chosen from the eps sweep as the amplitude at which the oscillatory shuttle-flux rms is ~0.6x the steady source-sink flux rms and the gamma = 1.8 Kanto network remains in the Physarum TL_MST band (1.78 +- 0.14). It is a calibration, not a measurement; the full eps sweep is reported so the dependence is visible.
